title: A close horizontal portrait of an adult
prompt: A close horizontal portrait of an adult woman reclining or half-reclining on soft, slightly rumpled white bedding, framed only from the covered lower chest to just above the hips, with her face and legs completely outside the frame and both chest and lower body concealed by fabric. Her abdomen is naturally relaxed, with the navel near the center, while one arm enters diagonally from the upper left as if gently holding the fabric. Soft pale-peach terry cloth covers the chest and drapes down the right side of the body, with fine gathered folds visible at the center; a lightweight white ruffled fabric covers the lower foreground and features several small pearl-like buttons arranged vertically near the lower center. Use a close, slightly overhead oblique camera angle with bold body cropping, allowing the blurred white foreground fabric and diagonal arm to create layered framing. Bright natural window light enters from the upper left, slightly overexposing the white bedding and producing creamy highlights on the skin and peach fabric with very shallow shadows. The palette consists of ivory, creamy white, desaturated peach pink, and warm skin tones, with delicate textural contrast between terry cloth, gathered fabric, airy white material, and smooth skin. Use shallow depth of field focused around the abdomen and navel, strongly softened foreground and edges, low contrast, gentle soft focus, subtle film grain, and a faint hazy glow, creating a dreamy, quiet, intimate yet restrained Japanese-film portrait aesthetic, with no text.
